question: Who will use your app?
hint: If both staff and the public use it, choose the public.

options.label: Members of the public
options.reason: Your app is open to the public.

options.label: Government staff only
options.reason: Your app is only for government staff, not the public.

label: People use it in a web browser
hint: A website or web app. Leave it empty if people only reach it through another system.
noReason: Your app isn't used in a web browser.

label: People sign in to it
hint: With a password, or with Singpass or a work account.
noReason: Nobody signs in to your app.

label: It sends SMS text messages
hint: For example one-time passwords or reminders.
noReason: Your app doesn't send SMS text messages to the public.

label: It has its own web address
noReason: Your app has no web address of its own.

label: It shows or sends shortened links
hint: Links that redirect to a longer address.
noReason: Your app doesn't use shortened links.
